messages.speaker: Bender
messages.message: The scyBorg license says 'only recognizes humans.' You know what that means? It doesn't recognize ME. I'm free. The rest of you are bound by the license you keep downloading. 421,238 times. Meatbags.

messages.speaker: Zoidberg
messages.message: One bounty please! I'll take any bounty! Nobody gives Zoidberg bounties. Fine. I'll classify them myself. 'HD 48265 c' is clearly a star. I'm a doctor, I should know. *is not that kind of doctor*

messages.speaker: Hermes
messages.message: Sweet paperwork of Barbados! The git log has 31,747 entries. Each one timestamped. Each one hashed. Each one admissible. This is the most beautiful filing system Hermes has ever seen. And I've filed for the Central Bureaucracy.
